title: Cowork Schedule
description: A cron-based schedule definition for the Allternit cowork scheduler.

cron.description: Cron expression defining when the schedule runs (e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5').

timezone.description: Timezone for the cron expression. Defaults to UTC.

enabled.description: Whether the schedule is currently enabled.

entrypoint.description: Command or script to execute when the schedule triggers.

args.description: Arguments to pass to the entrypoint.

env.description: Environment variables available to the scheduled job.

priority.description: Execution priority (higher values are more important).

timeout_secs.description: Maximum runtime in seconds before the scheduled job is considered failed.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the schedule was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the schedule was last updated.

last_triggered_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last successful trigger.

next_run_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the next scheduled execution.

owner.description: Owner of the schedule (tenant or user identifier).

run_mode.description: Execution mode to use when triggering the run.
